description: This file contains unit tests for the 'credits' utility functions and related data normalization logic within the project, including tests for conversion from USD to credits and field normalization for modal consumption.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Retrieves the number of credits per USD, defaulting to 20000 if environment variable is unset.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits based on environment variable or default rate.
